scope: Independent saved-pixel-only review of exactly the four remaining unchanged answer viewports in the designated manifest. No changed-choice images or other images were opened.
imageMethod: functions.view_image, once per manifest path in manifest order

boundedRule.protocolException: The current bounded rule and explicit four-image assignment supersede only the protocol's historical fixed-eight count. All other scope, observation and static-view restrictions apply.

observations.visibleArea: Complete answer sections 1 and 2, followed by heading 3 and the beginning of its prose.
observations: The centered text column has clear left and right margins. The prose in sections 1 and 2 is readable, with separated lines and no visible right-edge clipping or overlapping words.

The equation following the section 1 angle description sits on its own visible line. Its main symbols, equality sign and adjacent punctuation are separated; raised/lowered notation does not visibly collide with surrounding prose.
Section 2's speed-ratio expression and longer relative-index expression fit within the column. The operators and slash-separated terms remain visually distinct from the sentence text.

Section headings and horizontal separators are distinct and do not touch the neighboring paragraphs. Section 3 continues beyond the bottom capture boundary, where only the beginning of subsequent notation is visible; this is not evidence of a broken content container.
No figure is visible in this viewport, so figure framing is not applicable.
limits: The rest of section 3 is outside this saved viewport.
No exact font size, font identity or exhaustive identification of small subscript glyphs is certified.

Longer prose about backward extensions and the principal-axis construction wraps within the right margin. The final lines of section 7 remain above the separator.
Heading 8 has clear space above and below it. The magnification prose and the inline height-ratio expression fit within the column without touching the right edge.
The later expression with absolute-value bars is visually separated from its introductory text and punctuation. The concluding two lines are fully visible with space below them.
No figure is visible in this viewport, so figure framing is not applicable.
limits: This image supplies no evidence for sections between the first and final desktop viewports.
Visual separation of formula glyphs is reviewed, not mathematical correctness or exact font metrics.

No figure is visible in this viewport, so figure framing is not applicable.

observations.visibleArea: The final explanatory paragraphs of section 7 at the top capture boundary, followed by section 8 through its concluding sentence.
observations: The visible tail of section 7 wraps within the mobile margins. Its topmost line is close to the capture boundary but the visible words are readable; the preceding heading and earlier paragraphs are outside the image.
The last section 7 sentence ends before a distinct horizontal separator. Heading 8 and the following prose have clear spacing, without overlap.
In section 8 the height-description sentence breaks across lines, leaving the height-ratio expression intact on the following line with room before the right margin.

No figure is visible in this viewport, so figure framing is not applicable.
limits: The beginning of section 7 is not shown.
Formula layout is reviewed from the original saved image only; no zoom, crop, glyph measurement or semantic re-review was performed.

findingSummary: No definite visible readability, wrapping, overlap, mathematical-spacing or in-column clipping defect was found in the four supplied answer viewports.

reusedEvidence.policy: Existing source, science, English, choice, native and DOM approvals remain separate and are reused as directed, without re-review or new claims from pixels.

staticViewLimits: PASS covers only the actual visible pixels of these four saved answer viewports, not every answer, every scroll position or the entire lesson.
Capture boundaries limit evidence; offscreen continuations and partially visible boundary notation are not treated as definite container defects.
No precise font-size measurement, font-family confirmation, complete small-glyph audit or exact subscript transcription is claimed from the supplied image presentation.
No source fidelity, scientific correctness, English authorship, answer correctness or choice semantics were re-reviewed.
No interaction, judging, keyboard behavior, scrolling behavior, ARIA, complete English accessibility, fonts, unseen states or headed acceptance is certified.
No browser, native app, renderer, network, database, paid service, Git operation or product edit was used.
closesReadyScope: This four-image saved-pixel review is complete and ready to close alongside reused unchanged approvals. This is not ticket closure, publication authorization or full product acceptance.
